rom: the 318004-05 PAL KERNAL, as plus4emu 1.2.11 (git 939e652) ships it, run on kit/c16/machine.js
format: ram: the bytes at ramAt, two hex digits each; io: one access to three characters, a letter (R write $FD30, L write $FF08, K read $FF08, c read $FF13, C write $FF13) and the value in hex; changed: the RAM below $4000 the scan changed, but the stack page, as address:value in hex
